strNotes: Requires Phobos Framework 0.8.0+ and the Shipbreaker plugin. Includes wall processing, grabber, chute, paired residue collection and a 4 x 4 scrap reclaimer. New wall jobs produce identified residue; the reclaimer recovers steel/aluminium and retains rejects. Old jobs and unclassified residue keep their original meaning. Reclaimer Control Panel and phobosreclaimer commands open feed and controls; room atmosphere receives process heat. Native station stock, construction and maintenance included. No ejection or attached-hull cutting. Ordinary saves supported; in-game compatibility remains subject to testing. Translation catalogs use Framework language selection.
